description: Create an empty collection, or a sound board with kind "board", for the signed-in person. Use it when someone wants to save tracks for a project and none of their collections (list_collections) fits. Not for adding tracks; use add_to_collection or add_many_to_collection for that, with the returned id. Returns the new collection with its id and revision. Needs a signed-in account. Limits per kind: the Free plan allows 1 collection and 1 sound board, Pro up to 1,000 of each and 60 new ones per hour; over a limit the call fails with collection_limit. CC BY-NC tracks can only go in a collection with commercial false. Example: {"name":"Podcast intro","commercial":true}.

commercial.description: true (the default) marks the collection for commercial use, which keeps CC BY-NC tracks out; false allows them.

kind.description: collection (the default) or board, a collection the website plays as a grid of pads.

name.description: Collection name, 1 to 80 characters, such as "Podcast intro".

name: create_collection

archived_at.description: When the collection was archived, or null.

credits_heading.description: The credits block heading, or null for the default.

description.description: One line of plain text, or null.

read_only.description: true when a lapsed Pro plan has made this collection view-and-export only.

title: Create a collection
